prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW original photographic campaign asset for Frontaliere Ticino, a service that finds Swiss job offers suitable for a person's trade and prepares the applications for them. The provided images are REFERENCE IMAGES for the intended audience and practical working-world visual language, not edit targets; do not copy their layout, text, person identity or branding verbatim. Audience is ordinary Italian-speaking job seekers, especially tradespeople, production, maintenance and logistics workers. Visually direct, trustworthy and immediately Swiss; not luxury-office, fintech, abstract CV stationery or aspirational executive advertising. Premium realistic commercial photography with strong clear shapes, authentic faces, practical workwear, crisp focus, decisive contrast. Natural Swiss-red, navy and real workwear colors. A Swiss national flag can appear clearly in the environment (not a humanitarian Red Cross emblem). No company logos, no invented employer, no salary or job guarantee. No embedded words, lettering, numerals, icons, badges or button; the real advertisement will add very large HTML headline 'LAVORO IN SVIZZERA? LO CERCHIAMO NOI PER TE.' and CTA above/beside this photo. The image itself must feature the intended worker prominently, with a strong recognisable human face even at 100px crop width. Aspect LANDSCAPE3:1. A real-looking experienced construction/maintenance worker around40 in navy work jacket, yellow hard hat and orange safety vest, on a clean Ticino worksite with mountains and a clearly recognisable Swiss national flag behind. The worker occupies RIGHT35% of the image, visible head through chest, face at center-right and helmet entirely in frame; LEFT65% is a subdued softly defocused navy/slate industrial backdrop with simple depth, not empty pure white. Strong purposeful direct expression. Designed for horizontal728x90,970x90 and970x250 advertising, reads instantly at small size.
